note: What a viz item's proof rests on (facet proof create --domain viz). The engine reads routes, checks, project and builtin_modes from this file when present and keeps its built-in ones otherwise; this file names only the artifacts.

measure.note: How facet origin runs a criterion's check on the state after a step (work/<ITEM>/snap/<step>/, taken by vizflow.py when a step starts; the last state is work/<ITEM>/). The Blender checks cannot be re-run without Blender, so the state's own results files are read: the first one with a receipt that holds the check. Exit 0 holds, 1 does not, 2 cannot say.

chains.note: Where a criterion's value comes from, source first (FacetKit plan 2.8, facet origin). No viz tool compares these pairs yet: each is human, so a viz finding is traced by the snapshots of the steps or named by the reviewer.
